subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The croissant was _________, as was the coffee.
solution:
The correct answer is '**excellent**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**excellent**" means extremely good or outstanding. (उत्कृष्ट)
 
• The croissant and the coffee being described as "excellent" implies high quality and satisfaction.
 
• The other options: "**eloquent**," "**ambitious**," and "**inferior**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The croissant was excellent__, as was the coffee.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Eloquent (प्रभावशाली)**: means fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing, which is not suitable for describing food or drink.
 
• **Ambitious (महत्वाकांक्षी)**: means having a strong desire for success or achievement, which doesn’t fit here.
 
• **Inferior (निम्न)**: means lower in quality or value, which is opposite to the intended meaning.
